title: Coalitional influence when coalition size dominates
statement: Let $k,m:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and for each $q$ let $J_q$ be a set of $k(q)$ coordinates among $k(q)+m(q)$ coordinates. If $m(q)\to\infty$ and $k(q)/\sqrt{k(q)+m(q)}\to\infty$, then the probability that this coalition can make majority attain both possible outputs, for a uniformly random input, converges to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: each $J_q$ is a subset of the $k(q)+m(q)$ coordinates
